meta.note: Source-verified management guidance for chart-supported metrics. Annual financial guidance is anchored once at fiscal year-end and is never divided into quarters. Values marked chartable false are retained for audit completeness but are not rendered because their basis is not comparable to the chart metric. The ingestion source (AlphaSense-compiled research document) is distinct from the underlying company source (10-Q, earnings release, presentation, or transcript) cited on each record via 'source' and 'sourceLocation'. Records carry 'reportingCycle' to identify which quarterly cycle most recently confirmed the value; 'operator' preserves threshold semantics (>, <, >=) for values that are not ordinary midpoints.
